model_input_text:
Equation:
\partial_t u=D_u\Delta u,\qquad \partial_t v=D_v\Delta v.

Parameters:
D_u=0.01000000,\quad D_v=0.00500000.

Initial condition:
\eta(s)=\begin{cases}\exp\!\left(4-\frac{1}{s(1-s)}\right),&0<s<1,\\0,&s\in\{0,1\}.\end{cases}
q(0,x,y)=\alpha_q\eta(x)\eta(y)g_q(x,y),\quad q\in\{u,v\},\quad \alpha_q\sim\mathcal U[0.2,0.8].
g_q(x,y)=\frac{\sum_{\ell=1}^{3}w_{q\ell}\exp\!\left[-\frac{(x-\mu_{x,q\ell})^2+(y-\mu_{y,q\ell})^2}{2\sigma_{q\ell}^2}\right]}{\sum_{\ell=1}^{3}w_{q\ell}},\quad w_{q\ell}\sim\mathcal U[0.2,1],\quad\mu_{x,q\ell},\mu_{y,q\ell}\sim\mathcal U[0.25,0.75],\quad \sigma_{q\ell}\sim\mathcal U[0.08,0.18].
\text{Parameters are independently sampled between channels and rounded to eight decimal places.}

Boundary:
\partial_{\mathbf n}U(t,x,y)=0\quad\text{for }(x,y)\in\partial\Omega.

Domain:
\Omega=[0,1]^2,\qquad U=(u,v)^\top,\qquad \Delta=\partial_{xx}+\partial_{yy}.\quad x_p=(p+\tfrac12)/64,\ y_q=(q+\tfrac12)/64,\ p,q=0,\ldots,63.

Time:
0\leq t\leq1,\qquad t_n=n/99,\quad n=0,\ldots,99.\quad \text{Observed frames: }n\in\{0,25,50,74,99\}.
